title: Worker Image Certification — Cosign Signature, Digest Pinning, FFmpeg, Bootstrap
blocker: Docker daemon not accessible; cannot build, sign, or verify images
reviewer_feedback_applied: Replaced {{.Id}} fallback with explicit error (layer IDs aren't pinnable — only RepoDigests)
Replaced fragile grep string-matching on cosign verify output with exit-code check
Added OIDC identity skip when COSIGN_OIDC_ISSUER/IDENTITY env vars unset (local keyless flow)
Replaced grep -oP with portable grep -oE in verify-image-digest.sh
Fixed yt-dlp existence check to use --version (two dashes) instead of -version
Fixed worker-bootstrap-smoke.sh doctor probe to override CMD (avoids missing config.yaml)
Removed unnecessary --recursive flag from cosign sign commands

image.name: pipelinegen-worker
image.digest_note: Run 'make docker-build-worker && docker push pipelinegen-worker:latest && make docker-digest' to capture

ffmpeg_in_image.detail: Dockerfile line 89 installs ffmpeg via apt-get; script scripts/verify-ffmpeg.sh probes all 4 engine binaries

cosign_signature.note: Cosign v2.4+ required. Uses exit-code verification (not string-matching). Supports keyless (OIDC) and key-pair modes. Skips OIDC identity binding when env vars unset for local dev.

digest_pinned.detail: docker-compose.yml updated with IMAGE_DIGEST comment anchors; actual digest requires docker push first
digest_pinned.note: make docker-digest errors loudly if RepoDigests is empty (image not pushed) — NEVER falls back to {{.Id}}

digest_verified.note: Verifies running container digest matches pinned reference. Uses portable grep -oE (BSD + GNU).

bootstrap_preflight.detail: Worker pre-flight (cmd/worker/main.go) polls master /health for 30s with 1s interval; not verified at runtime

doctor_production.detail: Worker doctor has 8 probes (config, cert, filesystem, engine, registry, master_reachable, ready, runtime); smoke test overrides CMD to avoid missing config.yaml

yt_dlp_in_image.detail: Dockerfile downloads yt-dlp v2025.03.20; verify-ffmpeg.sh uses correct --version flag

python3_in_image.detail: Dockerfile installs python3 via apt-get; verified by verify-ffmpeg.sh

multi_stage_build.detail: Dockerfile has 4 stages (builder, server-runtime, worker-runtime, admin-runtime); worker-runtime copies only /out/worker binary

build_args_versioned.detail: Dockerfile accepts VERSION + COMMIT build args; Makefile passes git-derived values via LDFLAGS

healthcheck_master.detail: server-runtime target has HEALTHCHECK with 10s interval / 3s timeout / 20s start-period

scripts.purpose: Engine binary probe (ffmpeg, ffprobe, yt-dlp, python3)

makefile_targets: make docker-build-worker — builds worker-runtime target only
make docker-sign — build + sign with Cosign (keyless or key)
make docker-digest — print SHA256 digest (warns on missing push)
make docker-verify-digest — compare running container digest
make docker-verify-ffmpeg — probe engine binaries in image
make docker-bootstrap-smoke — smoke test worker binary
infrastructure_added.docker_compose: IMAGE_DIGEST= comment anchors for pipelinegen-server and pipelinegen-worker
